submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Create ONE finished game main-menu screen for the working label "Mindustry", landscape 16:9, requested native canvas 2560 x 1440. Opaque full-frame raster illustration, polished production art direction.
Input images: Image 1 is the primary approved mail UI style reference; Image 2 is the primary approved team UI style reference. Preserve their refined Daoist Chinese chibi hand-painted artwork, jade-green enamel, ivory silk-paper, warm gold fine borders, rounded cloud/ruyi edges, restrained red tassels. Use their visual finish, not their mail/party layout, portraits, text or game title.
Functional source: Mindustry v160.7 desktop MenuFragment. Show main navigation plus the expanded Play submenu. No shop, gacha, currencies or character-level HUD.
Composition: full painted atmospheric daytime background of a Daoist mechanical factory in a mountain valley, at high three-quarter perspective: compact jade-and-bronze refinery, connected ore conveyors, mineral mine, small round flying construction mechanisms, defensive turret and low wall, waterfalls and distant rounded peaks. Keep the industrial chain legible while the background behind menus is calm.
Logo at upper center: "Mindustry". Small version immediately beneath: "v160.7".
Left-middle: a modest tall ivory panel, about 22% canvas width, with six large vertically aligned navigation rows. The first row is selected dark jade with thin gold border; remaining rows ivory with dark jade readable Chinese. One simple painted icon per row.
Exact left navigation labels in order: "开始游戏", "资料库", "地图编辑器", "模组", "设置", "退出".
A second, slightly narrower ivory panel immediately to its right is the expanded selected Play submenu, four large aligned controls: "战役", "加入游戏", "自定义游戏", "载入游戏". All remain fully visible with generous spacing.
Large right half remains scenic factory artwork with no human portrait covering it. Bottom right small round community icon with text "社区"; small bottom-left note "美术概念 · 演示界面".
Rounded, tactile painted jade-and-gold major controls and cream paper secondary controls; crisp Chinese typography, high contrast, soft shading and fine gold craftsmanship. Chinese labels must be exactly as supplied; do not add arbitrary paragraphs.
Avoid realistic people, glossy plastic, pixel art, noisy textures, copied mail portraits, night sky, watermark, "五行奇谈", another Chinese game title, ornate full-image picture frame. This is a usable desktop main menu, not a poster. Target configured GPT Image 2.5 highest-quality artwork.
